comment: A bundled template's files are classpath resources, and a native image ships
only the resources it was told about. Without these, mainframe.exe builds
clean, lists the template, asks every question, and then cannot find a single
file to write -- a green build is not evidence for this.
It travels with the module rather than living in mainframe-dist so that
anything embedding mainframe-template gets it, which is the whole point of the
module being one. Every path the manifest can name is covered by the two globs;
